data: At approximately what epoch does the black dashed line reach the top of the fram in the right graph?

The black dashed line represents the cross-entropy loss for the DNN model without any augmentation. The question asks at approximately what epoch this line reaches the top of the frame in the right graph. 

Looking at the graph, the black dashed line appears to reach the top of the frame around epoch 50. This is visually evident as the line starts to level off and then begins to rise sharply after this point. Therefore, the answer is approximately epoch 50.
